title: FastKernels: benchmarking GPU kernel generation in production
gist: 384 kernel tasks taken from 47 real architectures, with baselines set to the kernels that production frameworks actually ship. Each candidate is scored alone and again after being swapped into the full model on the production path. Five agent systems were run for 6,900 agent-hours.
changes: Puts a number on how much isolated kernel results overstate. This is the discount to apply to every kernel speed-up quoted elsewhere on this site.
caveats: One GPU type. Equivalence was checked with a few forward passes, not task accuracy. No public leaderboard yet.

numbers.metric: Kernel-level speed-up once swapped into the full model
Winning kernel sets that ran correctly unmodified

bears_on.note: Isolated scores even mis-ranked the agents: the one that looked equal alone was three times better end to end.
For LLM serving specifically, agents landed at parity with what already ships.
